[size=4][b]Another pack, to be honest I haven't tested it yet, but it should work. [/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]BIG UPDATE! Now with new mechanics for catching and battling Pokémon. Catch Pokémon, battle Gym Leaders, and progress through the League to earn money. [/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Press K button to open menu. You can change button in this menu. [/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]PokeMorph Mature Pack[/b] is an adult-oriented character expansion for [b]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds[/b].
The pack adds five rift heroines inspired by monster-catching adventures.
This is a [b]Mature-only pack[/b]. Mature Content must be enabled in Isekai Bonds for its characters, stories, contracts, and portraits to become available.
Included heroines
[b]Altarita — Skybound Songstress[/b]
[b]Cynthia — Golden Champion[/b]
[b]Garderita — Keeper of Thoughts[/b]
[b]Lopun — Moonlit Sprinter[/b]
[b]Meloet — Muse of Resonance[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Valley Bonds. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds version 0.10.4 or newer. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download PokeMorph Mature Pack. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the[/color]

[code]PokeMorphMaturePack[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder into the character-pack directory included with Isekai Bonds. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enable [b]Mature Content[/b] and [b]Character Packs[/b] in the Isekai Bonds settings. [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The heroines participate in the weekly rotating roster. Not all five characters are guaranteed to appear during the same week.[/color]

This pack is intended for adult players.
It includes highly sexualised character designs, revealing outfits, lingerie-inspired clothing, mature relationship themes, and adult-oriented unlockable portraits. Some later bond portraits may contain nudity or otherwise explicit visual content.
All characters, stories, contracts, and portraits in this pack are marked as Mature and remain unavailable while Mature Content is disabled.

Compatibility notes
PokeMorph Mature Pack does not replace vanilla NPCs, maps, events, or items.

Пак предназначен только для совершеннолетних игроков.
Он содержит сексуализированные образы, откровенные наряды, элементы нижнего белья, взрослые темы отношений и Mature-портреты. Некоторые портреты поздних уровней связи могут содержать наготу или иной откровенный визуальный контент.
Все персонажи и контракты пака отмечены как Mature и не будут доступны при выключенном взрослом контенте.
